# PortalMenu

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** PortalMenu

## What it does

PortalMenu lets you open in-game menus — such as your inventory, chests, or the ClickGUI — while your character is standing inside a Nether portal or End portal. Normally, Minecraft suppresses screen interactions during portal teleportation, closing any open menu and preventing new ones from being opened. This module bypasses that restriction so you retain full menu access throughout the transition.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/portalmenu). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
